calls.thesis: BUY first tracked (guest Joel Litman, Altimetry Research) — MasTec is the electrical-contracting picks-and-shovels play for data centres and factories: backlog off the charts, inexpensive relative to earnings growth, a recent acquisition moves it inside the plant; potential to double, triple or quadruple over the next couple of years.
calls.base_case: Backlog supported by massive hyperscaler spend; earnings growth continues.
calls.bull_case: Smaller enabler with multi-bagger potential as AI infrastructure spend continues.
calls.bear_case: Holders who bought earlier in the year are now down for the year and need patience; a build-out slowdown would hit the backlog.
calls.video_title: 2 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought on the Dip (And 1 You'll Regret Owning)
